recognize_zh: 骨小樑之間有一顆巨大的多核巨細胞（multinucleated giant cell），細胞質豐富嗜伊紅，數十個核聚集於中央並部分沿周邊排列，細胞質內含一個圓形顆粒狀包涵體，外圍有小淋巴球與組織球環繞，背景為含嗜伊紅性球的反應性造血骨髓。
features: Very large multinucleated giant cell with abundant homogeneous eosinophilic cytoplasm lying between two bony trabeculae
Numerous oval vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli, clustered centrally and partly arranged at the periphery
Rounded granular/stellate intracytoplasmic inclusion within the giant cell
Surrounding cuff of small lymphocytes and epithelioid histiocytes
Background hypercellular marrow with numerous eosinophils, plasma cells and scattered megakaryocytes
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a large multinucleated giant cell with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, numerous centrally clustered and peripherally arranged nuclei, and a rounded granular intracytoplasmic inclusion. The giant cell is surrounded by epithelioid histiocytes and a cuff of small mature lymphocytes. The adjacent marrow is cellular with a reactive background rich in eosinophils and plasma cells, and megakaryocytes are present. No necrosis or atypical large cells are identified. Findings are consistent with a giant cell-containing granulomatous reaction in the marrow; infectious causes should be excluded with special stains.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single lobulated hyperchromatic nucleus and granular cytoplasm, not multiple separate vesicular nuclei in a histiocytic cytoplasm with a lymphocytic cuff.
Osteoclasts sit in Howship lacunae directly on the bone surface with uniformly distributed nuclei and no surrounding granulomatous cuff.
RS cells have two or a few nuclei with large inclusion-like eosinophilic nucleoli and are CD30/CD15 positive, unlike the many small-nucleolated nuclei of a histiocytic giant cell.
Infectious granulomas may look identical and require AFB and GMS stains, culture or PCR for exclusion.
